spawn_multi_process: spawn a single node multi-rank test process using torch.multiprocessing.spawn with a PGConfig
init_local_distributed_process_group: initialize a local single-rank distributed process group with nccl or gloo backend
ForkedPdb_set_trace: debug a forked multiprocessing child process by calling ForkedPdb().set_trace() on a specific rank
PGConfig_dataclass: create a PGConfig dataclass with backend, world_size, gp_group_size, and use_gp parameters
init_pg_and_rank_and_launch_test: initialize a process group and rank then launch a test method across distributed ranks
